key_toggle: Plate reader: show or hide the unit
key_bolo: Plate reader: BOLO the read plate
key_cite: Plate reader: cite the locked speed
key_layout: Plate reader: move and resize the unit
bolo_filed_body: Every plate reader is looking for %s.
error_timeout: The server didn't answer. Try again.
error_not_read: Read the plate first, then file the BOLO.
error_mdt_starting: The MDT is still starting. Try again in a moment.
error_too_fast: Wait a few seconds between BOLOs.
error_no_air_target: Lock the camera on a vehicle first.
setting_show_desc: The speed readings and plate strip on screen while you drive a car with the reader on. Hits and sightings still alert you when it's hidden, but the doppler tone goes quiet with it.
setting_layout_desc: How the speeds and plates are arranged. Slots gives each camera one row with its speed and plate. Stack lists the latest reads under the speeds. Lead shows the latest read full size with earlier ones small. Row puts everything on one line.
setting_plates_desc: The most plates shown at once. Holding the look key still shows the last five reads.
setting_read_seconds_desc: How long a clean plate stays on screen after it was read. Hits and locked plates stay regardless.
setting_details_desc: The vehicle name, camera and age next to each plate. Hits always show what they are.
setting_units_desc: Mph or km/h for target and fast speeds, the fast limit and the speed on citations.
setting_beeps_desc: Beeps when an antenna locks or unlocks, when a speeder is locked automatically, when a plate comes back as a hit and when another unit's reader spots a wanted car. Only you hear them.
setting_fast_limit_desc: The speed, in your chosen units, a car has to beat to show in the fast window, and the speed automatic locking reacts to. At 0 the fast window shows any faster car and automatic locking is off.
setting_auto_lock_desc: Locks the antenna on the first car caught over the fast limit. Does nothing while the fast limit is 0, and leaves a car you just unlocked alone for 20 seconds.
setting_tone_desc: A quiet tone that rises in pitch with the target's speed, while the reader is on and the unit is on screen. Only you hear it.
setting_tone_volume_desc: How loud the doppler tone plays. At 0 it stays silent with the tone still on.
error_full: The hot list is full. Clear a plate first.
error_not_listed: That plate isn't on the hot list.
error_mdt_active: On this server BOLOs are kept in the MDT.
key_hotlist: Plate reader: open the hot list
hot_add_desc: Every plate reader starts looking for it at once.
hot_empty_desc: Add a plate here, or file a BOLO from a plate the reader has read.
hot_field_stolen_desc: Readers call it a stolen vehicle instead of a BOLO.
hot_filed: Added by %s, %s. Stays until it is cleared.
hot_filed_expires: Added by %s, %s. Clears itself in %s h.
hot_sighting_by: Read by %s, %s. Select to mark it on your map.
hot_clear_body: Every plate reader stops looking for it and %s is closed.
hot_cleared_body: Plate readers no longer look for it.
